answer: Vouch-slot bond stops bulk fakes. A newcomer needs a member to spend a slot and lock an 80-credit pearl bond for an orchard row. The member files a lotus-sealed claim in the orchard registry; auditors replay it, and a voucher grafting fakes onto a row burns its pearl bond. Each fake needs a fresh slot plus 45: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and lock 80,000 against a 40,000 pool. A reused lotus seal exposes rented vouchers; honest newcomers pay 45 once.
